summary: Build an app that can generate and print properly formatted invoices (not just printing the on-screen view).

existing_features.title: Implement a dedicated, print-optimized invoice document layout that prints as a clean invoice (not a copy of the on-screen invoice detail UI). The printed output must exclude all app navigation/actions and exclude photo sections and edit/payment UI, while including core invoice information (logo, invoice number, paid/unpaid status, customer details, business address, line items, totals, and payment instructions).

Change the current Print and Download PDF actions on the invoice detail page to use the dedicated invoice document layout for printing/downloading, rather than relying on printing the current screen view. If a separate print route or print-only view is used, it must render only the invoice document content and then trigger the browser print dialog.

Update/extend print CSS so the invoice document layout prints with consistent page sizing/margins and avoids awkward page breaks in tables/sections, while keeping the regular (non-print) invoice detail page unchanged for on-screen use.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add proper invoice printing (formatted invoice layout for printing/PDF) instead of printing a copy of the screen.

projectName: Create proper printable invoice layout (not a screen print)
